subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: Should OpenClaw treat a workspace-discovered plugin at the same physical path as a matching official install record as the installed official plugin for trusted runtime state access?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow, but it changes a trusted-plugin state boundary and should be approved as a provenance rule rather than implemented as broad workspace trust.

options.title: Approve Same-Path Installed Provenance
options.body: Allow the fix only when the workspace candidate resolves to the same path as the persisted official install record and package/catalog identity still matches.

options.title: Keep Workspace Always Untrusted
options.body: Leave the gate unchanged and document that operators must avoid running with a workspace root that aliases `~/.openclaw`, which preserves strictness but keeps the reported official install broken.

options.title: Route Through Broader Trust Model
options.body: Defer this specific official WhatsApp failure to the broader self-hosted plugin trust design, delaying relief for the documented ClawHub install path.

recommendation.title: Approve Same-Path Installed Provenance
recommendation.body: Allow the fix only when the workspace candidate resolves to the same path as the persisted official install record and package/catalog identity still matches.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current trusted official install recognition and is best positioned to approve a narrow provenance-preserving adjustment.
